title: 【怒り】「女に生まれて損や！」国も動きだした“女性トイレ行列問題” 長蛇の列を劇的に解消した『次世代トイレ』の驚愕システムとは
titleTranslation: [Anger] "Being born a woman is a loss!" The government finally moves on the "women's restroom line problem" — the astonishing system of the "next-generation toilet" that dramatically ended the long lines (Yomiuri TV)
summary: The article examines why women face much longer restroom lines than men in Japan, and covers Japan's new government guidelines plus overseas laws and next-generation toilet designs aimed at fixing the imbalance.

sentences.text: 2025年、国交省の"トイレに関するアンケート"に「行列に並ばなければならない」と回答した人は、駅で男性35.3%・女性55.2%、商業施設で男性17.7%・女性47.4%でした。

sentences.translation: In a 2025 survey on toilets by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, the share of people who said they 'have to wait in line' was 35.3% of men and 55.2% of women at stations, and 17.7% of men and 47.4% of women at commercial facilities.

sentences.text: そんな中、国交省は2026年6月、女性トイレ"行列問題"の改善に向け、初めてトイレの便器数に関するガイドラインを策定しました。

sentences.translation: Amid this, in June 2026 the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism established guidelines on the number of toilets for the first time, aiming to improve the women's restroom 'line problem.'

sentences.translation: For facilities where male and female users are roughly equal in number, it states that 'the number of women's toilets should be equal to or greater than the number of men's toilets.'

sentences.translation: Meanwhile, according to the Ministry, the male-to-female ratio of toilet numbers is 1:0.63 at stations, 1:0.66 at airports, 1:0.89 at movie theaters, and 1:0.98 at stadiums/arenas.

sentences.text: 海外では、トイレの便器数に"設置基準"が定められている国もあります。

sentences.translation: In South Korea, there is a law requiring that at facilities with a capacity of 1,000 or more people, women's toilets be installed at 1.5 times or more the number of men's toilets (according to the Ministry).

sentences.text: 台湾では、駅・学校では男性1:女性5、オフィスでは男性1:女性3の比率で女性トイレを多くすることとなっています(現地メディアによる)。
sentences.translation: In Taiwan, the ratio favors women's toilets, at 1:5 (men:women) in stations and schools, and 1:3 in offices (according to local media).

sentences.text: 米・メリーランド州の公共施設では、女性トイレの数を男性トイレ以上とするのが州のルールとなっています(国交省による)。

sentences.translation: At public facilities in Maryland, USA, it is a state rule that the number of women's restrooms be equal to or greater than the number of men's restrooms (according to the Ministry).
